scope: Official ICDE DEFT/special track accepted-program paper lists, 2023–2026. The source programs do NOT distinguish Vision Papers from Expanding the Landscape. Themes and relevance are independent research-oriented editorial tags, NOT official ICDE classifications.

papers.title: Efficient Neural-Symbolic Data System via Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.why_relevant: Multi-agent coordination for neural-symbolic reasoning over data; compare against memory and query orchestration.

papers.title: VPS: Rethinking OLTP Database Performance Evaluation through Transactional Value
Living Databases: A Unified Model for Continuous Schema Evolution, Versioning, and Transformations
papers.why_relevant: Unifies schema evolution, versioning, lineage/provenance and change propagation; explores Prolly-tree-based implementation.

papers.title: Green or Greedy? An Ecological Analysis of Datacenter GPU Replacements
GenIE: Simulator-Driven Iterative Data Exploration for Scientific Discovery
papers.why_relevant: Iterative exploration and system-supported discovery; useful when considering learning agents over changing data.

papers.title: Towards a Hybrid Quantum-Classical Computing Framework for Database Optimization Problems in Real Time Setup
Training Data Distribution Estimation for Optimized Pre-training Data Management
Beyond Bandwidth Doubling: Embrace Bit-Flips & Unlock Processing-in-NAND
Unify: An Unstructured Data Analytics System
papers.why_relevant: Building blocks for querying and analyzing unstructured information, relevant to agent retrieval over text and media.

papers.title: SQL++: We Can Finally Relax!
Data Flow Architectures for Data Processing on Modern Hardware
Personal Manifold: Management of Personal Data in the Age of Large Language Models
papers.why_relevant: The closest DEFT precedent to organizing personal context and memories for LLM-based applications.

papers.title: Applications and Challenges for Large Language Models: From Data Management Perspective
papers.why_relevant: Identifies data management opportunities and challenges around language models.

papers.title: Routing with Massive Trajectory Data
When Data Pricing Meets Non-cooperative Game Theory
Secure Normal Form: Mediation Among Cross Cryptographic Leakages in Encrypted Databases
Reactive Knowledge Management
papers.why_relevant: Reactive rules across linked knowledge hubs enable graph knowledge to evolve as facts and domains change.

papers.title: LakeHarbor: Making Structures First-Class Citizens in Data Lakes
papers.why_relevant: Treats structure as an explicit data-layer concern; relevant to mixed-format structured memories.

papers.title: A CXL-Powered Database System: Opportunities and Challenges
Bifrost: A Future Graph Database Runtime
papers.why_relevant: Graph query runtime that adapts to evolving graph topology without fixed schemas.

papers.title: V2V: Efficiently Synthesizing Video Results for Video Queries
papers.why_relevant: Database view of video querying and result composition; bridge to video memory and retrieval.

papers.title: Higher-Order SQL Lambda Functions
The Metaverse Data Deluge: What Can We Do About It?
Relational Fabric: Transparent Data Transformation
papers.why_relevant: Transparent data transformations motivate traceable derived representations, including evolving memory views.

papers.title: Analytical Engines With Context-Rich Processing: Towards Efficient Next-Generation Analytics
Nested Loops Revisited Again
Understanding the Price of Data in Commercial Data Marketplaces
Amalur: Data Integration Meets Machine Learning
papers.why_relevant: Data integration plus learning, relevant to multi-source memory ingestion and consistency.

papers.title: SPA: Economical and Workload-Driven Indexing for Data Analytics in the Cloud
papers.why_relevant: Workload-driven indexing offers a database systems comparison for adaptive agent-memory indexes.

papers.title: Automated Data Cleaning Can Hurt Fairness in ML-based Decision Making

related_other_icde_tracks.title: TAPE: A Temporal Graph-based Memory System for Personal LLM Agents
related_other_icde_tracks.why_relevant: Direct prior art: temporal graph representation of an evolving personal-agent memory.

related_other_icde_tracks.title: Schema-GraphRAG: Bridging Hybrid Search and Graph Traversal for Complex Retrieval Tasks
related_other_icde_tracks.why_relevant: A practical hybrid-search-plus-graph system useful for reasoning about memory retrieval.

related_other_icde_tracks.title: LazyVLM: Neuro-Symbolic Approach to Video Analytics
related_other_icde_tracks.why_relevant: Closest demo for a database-style video query or video memory system.

related_other_icde_tracks.title: Data-Centric Foundations of Agentic AI
related_other_icde_tracks.why_relevant: Survey/tutorial of memory, agentic RAG, multiagent systems and self-evolving agents; not an accepted research or DEFT paper.

related_other_icde_tracks.title: AGRAG: Advanced Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLMs
related_other_icde_tracks.why_relevant: Graph-based retrieval augmented generation, relevant for a strong database prior-art review.

related_other_icde_tracks.title: PRO-HNSW: Proactive Repair and Optimization for High-Performance Dynamic HNSW Indexes
related_other_icde_tracks.why_relevant: Maintaining a rapidly changing vector index—important for update-heavy memory systems.

quality_note: 2023 official program shows 8 papers in two special track sessions. Covers presented papers, not all submissions/acceptances ever announced; titles normalized for punctuation and typos.
